sourceChecks.text: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ペオル事件で殺されたイスラエル人ジムリは、シメオン族の父祖の家の長サルの子と記されます。
